messages:
incidents-bot: Pager alert — high error rate from inference-pool-us-central2 (service: infer-v2). 95p latency spike and 5xx surge. paging @oncall :rotating_light:
Ana (oncall): ack. grabbing logs + routing map. any known deploys?
Raj (infra): no deploys in last 30m. saw node churn in us-central2-a around 3752468840. kubelet restarted on 3 nodes.
Cassie (sre): seeing repeated PodEvicted / NotReady transitions for gpu-node-uk-*-us-central2. kubelet logs show: 
```
W0730 12:14:02.123 kubelet_node_status.go:123] NodeNotReady: kubelet failed heartbeat
E0730 12:14:03.456 kubelet.go:345] kubelet: container runtime restart: containerd exited
```

Raj (infra): also pulled GPU driver messages from the node: 
```
NVRM: GPU at PCI:0000:65:00: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
cublasCreate() failed: CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED
```

Ana (oncall): that matches customer reports — error rate up on model endpoints backed by that pool. How many pods evicted?
Raj (infra): approx 18 pods across 3 nodes. autoscaler didn't immediately replace due to image pull delays for the warm pool.
Cassie (sre): quick mitigation: cordon + drain the 3 flapping nodes so scheduler stops placing new pods, and scale up dedicated warm-pool in us-central2 to take traffic. can someone run the drain?
Ana (oncall): doing it now. 
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-usc2-01
kubectl drain gpu-node-usc2-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

Raj (infra): I spun up 4 warm nodes (n1-gpu-4) with pre-pulled image and quantized model variant to reduce GPU memory. routing rule: route 60% to warm-pool, 40% to eu fallback. pushing routing change.
SupportBot: Routing update applied to route-infer: us-central2->warm-pool (60%) eu-west1 (40%).
Luis (customer-success): FYI — two paying customers reported degraded latency and some 5xx. I've opened a ticket and put a temporary banner on their dashboards. they're asking for ETA.
Ana (oncall): ETA depends on stabilizing nodes. draining and replacement should be ~6-10m. will keep customers updated.
Cassie (sre): looking at heap/KV cache usage in pods that crashed — memory footprint spike before crash. suspect an aggregation of long-running KV cache + large batch spike. logs snippet: 
```
2026-07-30T12:12:45Z runtime: failed to allocate device memory: allocation failed on GPU 0
runtime/kvcache.go:223: cache resize triggered by seqlen=2048
```

Raj (infra): driver Xid 79 usually indicates a GPU driver/kernel issue; nodes show repeated kernel oops around the time of kubelet restart. I've requested node reprovisioning and driver reinstall on the 3 hosts.
Ana (oncall): good. for immediate customer protection, can we enable model-variant fallback globally for this pool so we avoid heavy kv-cache usage? maybe use quantized-8bit variant.
Raj (infra): done. set fallback policy to quantized-8bit for affected model routes.
SupportBot: Fallback policy applied: affected endpoints now default to quantized-8bit when node health degrades.
Luis (customer-success): customers appreciate quick mitigation — asking again for post-incident summary and whether any data loss.
Cassie (sre): no data loss expected — inference requests either succeeded with fallback or returned 5xx. we'll capture detailed error counts. I'll start the incident timeline and collect metrics: p95 latency, 5xx rate, token throughput.
Ana (oncall): handing off to Raj for long-lived infra work. I'm staying on to verify customers. @Raj please escalate to infra rotation if driver reinstall fails.
Raj (infra): taking over. will update in this thread with node reprovision status.
Cassie (sre): notes for postmortem: consider autoscaler pre-pull for warm nodes during noisy neighbor windows, tighten KV cache eviction thresholds, and add driver health probe to node exporter.
incidents-bot: Incident acknowledged by Ana (oncall) at 3752468902. Severity: Sev2.
SupportBot: Logged customer tickets: #CUST-4981, #CUST-4982.
Raj (infra): node reprovision started. replacing gpu-node-usc2-01/02/03 -> new images coming up. monitoring GPU Xid errors.
Ana (oncall): thanks. I'll update customers in 10m or earlier when we have stable p95. leaving note: oncall->Raj (infra) handoff at 3752468920.
Raj (infra): reprovision succeeded on 2/3 nodes, last node had kernel panic during image install, recreating. pods rescheduled to warm-pool. 5xx rate back down to baseline.
Cassie (sre): verifying metrics — p95 back to normal at 3752468948, 5xx drop from 6.2% -> 0.8%.
Luis (customer-success): relaying to customers that service is stabilizing and we'll follow up with RCA. thanks team. :heart:
Ana (oncall): closing initial pager here; keeping monitoring for 30m. follow-up doc and RCA owners: Cassie + Raj.
__notes: Single-string Slack thread representation. Messages in chronological order, prefixed by sender. No title field per agents.md.
